name: SOC 2
notice: Criterion IDs with Assayr's own summaries. Use the AICPA Trust Services Criteria for the criteria text.

criteria.title: Integrity and ethical values
criteria.summary: A code of conduct sets expected behaviour, staff accept it, and breaches are dealt with.
criteria.evidence_hint: Signed code of conduct and handling of breaches

criteria.title: Board oversight
criteria.summary: The board or an equivalent body is independent of management and oversees how internal control works.
criteria.evidence_hint: Board or committee minutes covering security oversight

criteria.title: Structures, reporting lines and authority
criteria.summary: Management sets up the structure, reporting lines and authority needed to meet the service commitments.
criteria.evidence_hint: Organisation chart and security role descriptions

criteria.title: Competence
criteria.summary: The organisation hires, trains and keeps people with the skills its controls need.
criteria.evidence_hint: Job descriptions, background checks and training records

criteria.title: Accountability
criteria.summary: People are held to account for their part in internal control, for example through reviews and discipline.
criteria.evidence_hint: Performance reviews and disciplinary policy

criteria.title: Quality information for control
criteria.summary: The organisation gets and uses relevant, good quality information to run its controls.
criteria.evidence_hint: System inventory, data flow diagrams and monitoring reports

criteria.title: Internal communication
criteria.summary: Staff are told about objectives and their control responsibilities, and have a way to raise issues.
criteria.evidence_hint: Policy acknowledgements, awareness training and whistleblowing channel

criteria.title: External communication
criteria.summary: Customers and other outside parties get the information they need, and can report problems.
criteria.evidence_hint: Service terms, system description and external contact channel

criteria.title: Objectives specified
criteria.summary: Objectives are clear enough that the risks to them can be identified and assessed.
criteria.evidence_hint: Documented service commitments and security objectives

criteria.title: Risk identification and analysis
criteria.summary: Risks to objectives are identified and analysed across the organisation to decide how to manage them.
criteria.evidence_hint: Risk assessment and risk register

criteria.title: Fraud risk
criteria.summary: The chance of fraud is considered when risks are assessed.
criteria.evidence_hint: Risk assessment entries covering fraud

criteria.title: Change affecting controls
criteria.summary: Significant changes that could affect internal control are identified and assessed.
criteria.evidence_hint: Change risk reviews

criteria.title: Ongoing and separate evaluations
criteria.summary: Controls are checked through ongoing monitoring and separate evaluations such as internal audits.
criteria.evidence_hint: Internal audit reports and control self-assessments

criteria.title: Deficiencies communicated
criteria.summary: Control weaknesses are reported in time to the people who must fix them, including management.
criteria.evidence_hint: Deficiency log and remediation tracking

criteria.title: Control activities selected
criteria.summary: Controls are chosen and built to bring risks down to acceptable levels.
criteria.evidence_hint: Risk treatment plan mapped to controls

criteria.title: Technology general controls
criteria.summary: General controls over technology are chosen and built to support the objectives.
criteria.evidence_hint: IT general control descriptions

criteria.title: Policies and procedures deployed
criteria.summary: Controls are put in place through policies that say what is expected and procedures that make it happen.
criteria.evidence_hint: Approved policies and operating procedures

criteria.title: Logical access security
criteria.summary: Software, infrastructure and architecture restrict logical access to protected information assets.
criteria.evidence_hint: Access control policy, MFA and encryption configuration

criteria.title: User registration and credentials
criteria.summary: Users are registered and authorised before they get credentials, and credentials are removed when no longer needed.
criteria.evidence_hint: Access request and approval records

criteria.title: Access granted, changed and removed
criteria.summary: Access is granted, changed and removed based on roles, least privilege and segregation of duties.
criteria.evidence_hint: Access reviews and leaver removals

criteria.title: Physical access
criteria.summary: Physical access to facilities and protected assets is limited to authorised people.
criteria.evidence_hint: Badge access lists and visitor logs

criteria.title: Asset disposal
criteria.summary: Data and software are removed from assets before they are disposed of or reused.
criteria.evidence_hint: Disposal certificates and wipe records

criteria.title: Protection from external threats
criteria.summary: Logical access controls protect against threats from outside the system boundary.
criteria.evidence_hint: Firewall rules, intrusion detection and VPN configuration

criteria.title: Data transmission and removal
criteria.summary: Moving and removing information is restricted to authorised users and protected in transit.
criteria.evidence_hint: TLS configuration and data loss prevention settings

criteria.title: Malicious software
criteria.summary: Controls stop or detect unauthorised or malicious software.
criteria.evidence_hint: Anti-malware deployment and alert records

criteria.title: Vulnerability and configuration monitoring
criteria.summary: Detection and monitoring find configuration changes and new vulnerabilities.
criteria.evidence_hint: Vulnerability scans and configuration baselines

criteria.title: Anomaly monitoring
criteria.summary: System components are monitored for anomalies that could mean attacks, errors or failures.
criteria.evidence_hint: Logging and alerting setup with alert reviews

criteria.title: Security event evaluation
criteria.summary: Security events are evaluated to decide whether they are incidents.
criteria.evidence_hint: Event triage records

criteria.title: Incident response
criteria.summary: Confirmed incidents are handled through a defined response programme.
criteria.evidence_hint: Incident response plan and incident tickets

criteria.title: Incident recovery
criteria.summary: Activities to recover from security incidents are identified, built and carried out.
criteria.evidence_hint: Recovery plans, tests and post-incident reviews

criteria.title: Change management
criteria.summary: Changes to infrastructure, data, software and procedures are authorised, tested, approved and documented.
criteria.evidence_hint: Change tickets with approvals and test evidence

criteria.title: Business disruption risk
criteria.summary: Risks of business disruption are identified and mitigation activities are chosen.
criteria.evidence_hint: Business continuity plan and insurance

criteria.title: Vendor and partner risk
criteria.summary: Risks from vendors and business partners are assessed and managed.
criteria.evidence_hint: Vendor inventory, assessments and contracts
